name: it.proofprofile/proofit
title: ProofProfile evidence (paid proof, free name search)
description: Is this song AI generated? Paid x402 proof a recording existed before 2022, anchored in Bitcoin.

tools.name: verify_recording
tools.description: PAID, from one cent in USDC by x402; the first reply is the price and nothing is charged until the AI agent signs a payment. Evidence that a recording, by ISRC, exists in the frozen ProofProfile corpus: record hash, the Bitcoin-anchored OpenTimestamps proof, the CopyrightChains block, and how to check it. If a recording the person asked about is not found and find_recording lists other versions of that title, verify those too and report what each shows, naming the version; one version is never proof of another. Returned with a capsule that verifies offline and a receipt of this call anchored in Bitcoin. For checking whether a song may be AI generated: a recording in the register existed before 2022, when its source, AcousticBrainz, closed. That is evidence of age, never of human origin.

declaredValueUsd.description: The stakes in US dollars the AI agent is acting on. They set the price band (one cent under $100, ten cents from $100, one dollar from $10,000); undeclared stakes are priced at one cent. The declared figure is part of the call that the receipt anchors in Bitcoin, so the receipt shows it. No money other than the price moves.

purpose.description: Optional: what the AI agent is about to do, in its own words. Bound into the anchored receipt as part of the call, so the receipt shows why it was made.

reference.description: Optional: the AI agent's own reference for the action, such as an order id or sha256:<hash> of its document. Bound into the anchored receipt as part of the call.

isrcs.description: Several ISRCs in one call, in place of isrc: one payment, one receipt

tools.name: find_recording
tools.description: FREE. Discover recordings by artist name, or read one artist's sealed catalogue by artist_id. Supply exactly one of artist or artist_id, optionally title and page. Name search is partial: at most three artist files are read; artistCandidates lists the returned name matches, not necessarily every namesake or only census artists. Show returned recording matches with a brief incomplete-search warning; avoid attributing all matches to one artist without evidence or asking people to pick between indistinguishable IDs. If an artist ID was supplied, use it directly and confirm the selected name and ID. Select an artist_id from those candidates and page through that artist's matching recordings, 25 per page. Release pages are listing context, not proof of a release. Verify the intended recording by ISRC. A name-search miss does not establish absence.

title.description: Recording title, for example The Boys of Summer. Leave it out for all of the artist's recordings.

artist.description: Artist name, for example Don Henley

artist_id.description: Registry artist id from artistCandidates or an artist page; use instead of artist

page.description: Page of matching recordings, 25 per page, with or without title
